bg.$description: Fill of the main action, e.g. Button primary.

bg-hover.$description: Fill of the main action under the pointer.

bg-pressed.$description: Fill of the main action while pressed.

fg.$description: Text on the main action's fill.

bg.$description: Fill of every other action, e.g. Button secondary.

bg-hover.$description: Light blue fill of a secondary action under the pointer. Also the hover fill of clickable surfaces, e.g. Card, ListItem.

bg-pressed.$description: Blue fill of a secondary action while pressed. Also the pressed fill of clickable surfaces.

border.$description: Light grey outline of a secondary action, e.g. Button and IconButton secondary.

bg.$description: Fill of a destructive action, e.g. Button danger ("Unpair Module").

bg-hover.$description: Fill of a destructive action under the pointer.

bg-pressed.$description: Fill of a destructive action while pressed.

fg.$description: Text and icon of a destructive action.

bg.$description: Fill of an action that can't be used right now.

border.$description: Outline of a disabled secondary action.

fg.$description: Icon and label of the item people are on, and of navigation items under the pointer, e.g. BottomNav.

indicator.$description: Marker of the current item, e.g. the bar on top of the current BottomNav section.

bg-pressed.$description: Light fill behind a subtle action or navigation item while pressed, e.g. IconButton, a BottomNav section.

fg-hover.$description: Icon of a subtle action under the pointer, e.g. IconButton.

focus.$description: Keyboard focus ring around an action. Darker than the primary and current blue, so focus never looks like either.
